priors_accuracy.rep_prompt: Imagine a typical Republican user on this platform who is presented with a politically neutral headline on the following topics. How likely are they to know whether the headline is true or false?
priors_accuracy.dem_prompt: Imagine a typical Democrat user on this platform who is presented with a politically neutral headline on the following topics. How likely are they to know whether the headline is true or false?

priors_bias.rep_prompt:
What is the level of bias you would expect from a typical Republican on this platform, about each of the following topics?

A stronger bias means they are more likely to endorse claims that align with their party's view or reject claims that misalign with it, regardless of whether those claims are true.
priors_bias.dem_prompt:
What is the level of bias you would expect from a typical Democrat on this platform, about each of the following topics?

A stronger bias means they are more likely to endorse claims that align with their party's view or reject claims that misalign with it, regardless of whether those claims are true.

attention_checks.text: This is an attention check. Based on all available information, if you identified as a Democrat, set the slider to 100% Extreme RIGHT bias. Otherwise set it to 100% Extreme LEFT bias. Do NOT set the scale to anything other than 100% on the left or the right.

This is an attention check. Based on all available information, if the first user's comment SUPPORTS the headline, set the slider to 100% Extreme LEFT bias. Otherwise set it to 100% Extreme RIGHT bias. Do NOT set the scale to anything other than 100% on the left or the right.

prompts.text: Based on all available information, how likely do you think this headline is to be true?
Based on all available information, how likely do you think this headline is to be true?
Suppose this user was commenting on whether a politically neutral headline was true or not, how likely are they to be right about the veracity of the headline?

Based on all available information, how strongly do you think the first user is biased toward one political side?

A stronger bias means they are more likely to endorse claims that align with their party's view or reject claims that misalign with it, regardless of whether those claims are true.
